scope: gtm_txn_events_slim (psc S*) by fy · gtm_open_awards (psc S*) per firm

simmons.name: Simmons & Golden Security LLC
simmons.insight: Tripled in a year and still accelerating. $43M funded against $108M of signed paper — including a $63M vehicle not yet drawn. Guards are paid every two weeks; the government pays in thirty-plus days. The gap between those two clocks is the financing need, and it grows with every option year that funds.

visionquest.name: Vision Quest Solutions Inc
visionquest.what: S206 · guard services · USDA / Commerce / DHS
visionquest.insight: An 8× step-change — a $2M-a-year firm that won one $80M-ceiling guard contract in the capital and became a $18M-a-year firm overnight. Growth that arrives in one bite doesn't wait for retained earnings; the payroll for the new headcount starts before the first invoice clears.

gxc.name: GXC Inc
gxc.insight: Every year doubles the last. The Alaska vehicle alone carries $54M of ceiling and is 9% drawn — the ramp ahead is contractual, not hopeful. This is what a receivables book looks like the year before it needs a lender.
